title: AnimationPlayer does not use unique node paths when child of scene root
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f] - Reproducible in: v4.7.1.rc1.official [17e2686e0] ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.43 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When adding a new track with the AnimationPlayer targeting a unique node, it will automatically use the unique syntax with %. However, if the AnimationPlayer's parent is the scene root, it will instead use the relative node path instead. Ideally, the AnimationPlayer should always use a unique path when possible when adding or changing the nodepath to stay consistent. Especially because animation tracks pointing to the same node with unique paths and local paths will be grouped separately as if they were under separate nodes. A workaround for this would be to nest the AnimationPlayer within another node, as shown in the MRP below. This allows it to create tracks with % as expected. Interestingly, changing the AnimationPlayer's `root_node` field doesn't change the behavior, like I initially thought it would. I noticed https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/70531 is similar to this issue, in that both of them involve AnimationPlayer changing track paths of unique nodes incorrectly. However, nesting the AnimationPlayer does not appear to fix that issue. I've tested it in 4.7.stable and reproduced that issue's MRP. Also related to proposal https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4847 regarding menu to change track node paths. This could cause the button to unexpectedly convert unique paths to local paths. ### Steps to reproduce MRP Reproduction: - Go to both AnimationPlayer nodes, and add a new track of any kind (I used 3D Position) to the `MyUniqueNode` (MRP has tracks added already) - AnimationPlayer1 has unique path `%MyUniqueNode` - AnimationPlayer2 has local path `MyUniqueNode` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [unique-path-animationplayer-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29652868/unique-path-animationplayer-mrp.zip)
